governing_rule: Smallest sufficient repair through existing authority. No D04 criterion changes. Fix attempts earn zero until original condition is retested.

findings.root_cause: Close is a work projection without a durable projection contract or completeness boundary, so it can be empty/stale while the canonical ledger remains correct.
findings.patch: Create a canonical Close projection contract that explicitly scopes which lifecycle states must appear in Close, binds canonical opportunity keys to CRM opportunity IDs, records projection timestamp/state/evidence, and reconciles all currently in-scope records. CRM probability defaults must never be treated as Matrix evidence.
findings.acceptance: Current in-scope canonical records and Close active opportunities reconcile one-to-one by canonical key/state/value where value is known; readback shows no missing in-scope record and no stale active projection.

findings.root_cause: Behavioral acceptance lagged implementation. PR #25 and #26 were technically merged while original failed behaviors remained open until later live runs.
findings.patch: Persist behavioral acceptance receipt for #24 and #26 from the eight-record MISSING_RECORD_UPSERT run and post-merge no-op run; close #24 only after readback; preserve merge != acceptance rule.
findings.acceptance: #24 closed with exact ingest→persist→readback evidence; #26 acceptance records four consecutive state_changed:false ticks and no no-op commit.

findings.root_cause: Reversibility exists informally through Git history/branches/holds but lacks one enterprise-explicit rollback contract.
findings.patch: Add one rollback/reversibility control defining pre-change snapshot, change ID, reversible/internal vs irreversible/external actions, rollback authority, rollback method, post-rollback tests/readback, and prohibition on pretending external sends/payments can be rolled back.
findings.acceptance: Control is durable, read back, and applied to the current #25/#26 change family.

findings.root_cause: Build evidence has deployment receipts, but same-commit test→promotion→live-readback linkage is not represented as one current deployment provenance record.
findings.patch: Create deployment provenance receipt for the two benchmark builds from existing exact commits/CI/deployment evidence. Do not invent a live URL or same-commit relation not already evidenced.
findings.acceptance: Each benchmark record names tested commit, CI acceptance, promoted/deployed commit, and independent readback; any missing link remains explicit HOLD rather than PASS.

findings.root_cause: Runtime-open/work-conservation law exists but prior sessions repeatedly terminated on reporting or one completed item.
findings.patch: Use this remediation run itself as a bounded acceptance: continue through FORX analysis, Intake persistence, fix implementation, retest, and final consolidated result without voluntarily terminating between stages. Persist one run-conservation receipt after completion.
findings.acceptance: One continuous evidenced run crosses at least four materially different work classes without owner restart: forensic analysis→patch persistence→implementation→retest.

findings.root_cause: Provider/tool fallback behavior exists ad hoc but no single tested critical-route matrix proves alternates for each consequential function.
findings.patch: Create a critical-route fallback register covering canonical read/write, external email, CRM projection, browser/form execution, payment observation, compute/build, and file/evidence storage. For each: primary route, tested alternate, last test receipt, remaining single-point gate.
findings.acceptance: Every critical function has either a tested independent alternate or an explicit irreducible OWNER/EXTERNAL_GATE; no function is falsely called redundant.

findings.root_cause: Connector role isolation is strong but app-level permissions are broad; current readback shows GitHub/Gmail/Close/TinyFish/Drive set to 'Allow all actions'.
findings.patch: Perform least-privilege permission review and reduce permissions only where the exact operational requirement is understood and Owner/security authority permits. Do not auto-restrict critical connectors blindly.
findings.acceptance: Documented per-app required action classes and approved permission posture; no excess privilege without rationale.

findings.root_cause: Provider risks are evidenced across receipts but not normalized into one current supplier-risk register.
findings.patch: Create supplier/provider risk register with provider, critical function, observed failure modes, free-tier/account constraints, data/security exposure, fallback route, owner, last test, and residual risk.
findings.acceptance: All currently critical providers in D04 evidence have a current row and fallback/risk disposition.

findings.root_cause: Controlled-source practice exists but no enterprise-explicit retention/access policy was found.
findings.patch: Create evidence/PII retention-access policy using existing AMX truth: data minimization, private-source/public-safe projection, secrets excluded from public evidence, retention by evidence class, supersession without silent deletion, governed deletion, and access/readback logging.
findings.acceptance: Durable policy exists, contains explicit retention/access rules, and does not fabricate legal requirements or retention periods not adopted by AMX.

findings.root_cause: Recovery happens operationally, but no formal security recovery exercise ties detect→contain→recover→verify into one receipt.
findings.patch: Run a non-destructive tabletop against a realistic connector credential/provider-compromise scenario and a public/private evidence leakage scenario. Record detection signal, containment, alternate route, restoration, verification, and unresolved Owner-only action.
findings.acceptance: Exercise receipt demonstrates all response stages without exposing secrets or performing destructive actions.

findings.root_cause: FORX can select diversely and consume outcomes conceptually, but there is no durable causal receipt proving one real outcome changed a specific weight/state and changed the next selection.
findings.patch: Extend the existing FORX selection path—not a new weighting system—with scoped outcome adjustments and a causal receipt. Use at least three real outcomes already in the ledger: REJECTED, WRONG_ROUTE, RESPONDED. Record event→affected dimension→before priority→after priority→changed next selection→durable readback.
findings.acceptance: Three real outcome classes survive a continuation boundary and at least one changes the actual next selected candidate while preserving anti-overfit/diversity.

findings.root_cause: Only directly observable rails can be authoritatively closed; not all approved receive rails are currently connector-observable.
findings.patch: Banker must enumerate approved rails and classify each DIRECTLY_OBSERVED / INDIRECT_RECEIPT_ONLY / PROVIDER_LIMITED / UNKNOWN_UNOBSERVED. Do not claim all-rail close until every material receive rail has authoritative evidence.
findings.acceptance: All approved rails have a current observation class and period-close evidence; otherwise control remains PARTIAL.

findings.root_cause: The system has offers/submissions/responses but no evidenced current accepted scope/price→contract→invoice/receivable→paid/settled chain.
findings.patch: Do not manufacture an architecture fix. Existing PRI must prioritize the strongest current RESPONDED/OFFERED item and progress the real buyer through explicit scope/price acceptance, commitment, invoice and settlement where the buyer agrees. Banker verifies terminal states.
findings.acceptance: One attributable real opportunity completes the chain with external receipts. Until then these controls remain FAIL/PARTIAL by design.

findings.root_cause: Responses exist but response conversion is not yet reliable across qualified opportunities.
findings.patch: Prefer warm/responded routes and proof-of-work trials; measure response-to-next-step conversion, not send volume.
findings.acceptance: Attributable repeated substantive responses and at least one progressed buyer next step.

implementation_order: Commercial outcome controls remain externally outcome-dependent
